tip.en: Only 90 seconds in and HR has climbed from 84 to 121 — a rise of 37 bpm on flat ground. Your recent solo runs show a much gentler warm-up curve; the social energy with Eleen is pushing you out harder than intended from the gun.
tip.zh: 仅跑了90秒，心率已从84跳升至121，在平坦地面上涨幅达37次/分。与Eleen同跑时的社交节奏显然让你一开始就跑得比计划更用力，建议有意识地压住前1公里的配速。

tip.en: At 0.6 km HR hits 137 — your historical average for entire runs — and continues climbing. On a zero-elevation course this early crossing signals you're running this 'easy' outing at a true moderate effort, not recovery pace.
tip.zh: 0.6公里处心率达到137次/分，这已是你近期跑步的平均心率，而全程地形平坦。如此早突破这一阈值，说明这次所谓的'轻松跑'实际上是中等强度，并非恢复配速。

title.en: HR 150 on Flat Ground — Zone Creep

tip.en: HR crosses 150 at 1.6 km with pace around 5:05 and zero grade. Your recent 5K runs rarely held 150+ for sustained periods; this crossing on flat terrain with a training partner suggests conversational pace has quietly become a tempo effort.
tip.zh: 1.6公里处心率突破150次/分，配速约5:05，坡度为零。近期训练中心率维持在150以上的情况较少见；平地上与训练伙伴同跑时不知不觉从'对话配速'变成了'节奏跑强度'，需警惕。

title.en: Brief Bridge Ramp, HR Already at Ceiling

tip.en: A 2–3% grade kicker at 3.1 km pushes HR to 157–158 — matching the max ever recorded in your recent history. Notably your pace barely drops (5:42–5:47), meaning you absorbed the ramp by cardiac cost rather than slowing down.
tip.zh: 3.1公里处出现2–3%坡度，心率攀升至157–158次/分，追平近期历史最高值。值得注意的是，你的配速几乎没有降低（约5:42–5:47），说明你靠提高心脏负荷而非减速来应对这段坡度。

tip.en: HR peaks at 160 bpm at 3.5 km on completely flat ground at a 5:42 pace — higher than any effort in your last 8 runs and 23 bpm above your recent average. This is a red flag for a run billed as a social jog; cumulative fatigue or dehydration may be compounding the effect.
tip.zh: 3.5公里处在完全平坦路面上心率峰值达160次/分，配速约5:42——超过近8次跑步的历史最高心率，高出近期平均心率23次。对于一次社交慢跑而言这是警示信号，累积疲劳或脱水可能是叠加因素。

tip.en: Pace collapses from ~6:00 to 11:44 within four data points at 3.8 km, while HR drops from 150 to 148 and continues falling. This involuntary slowdown is the direct consequence of running too hard for too long — your aerobic system finally demanded a rest.
tip.zh: 3.8公里处配速在短短四个数据点内从约6:00骤降至11:44，心率从150开始下滑。这次非自愿的减速是长时间过度用力的直接后果——有氧系统终于提出了休息的要求。

title.zh: 第二次停顿：跑步中途长时间停止

tip.en: Pace hits 14:07 and effectively stops for over a minute at 4.3 km with HR still around 143–147. Two walk/stop breaks in the final 1 km of a 4.76 km run is a clear pattern: the first half was run at a cardiac cost the second half couldn't sustain. With Eleen, agree on a ceiling HR — perhaps 145 — to keep the full run genuinely runnable.
tip.zh: 4.3公里处配速降至14:07并近乎停止超过一分钟，此时心率仍在143–147次/分。在不足5公里的跑步最后1公里内出现两次步行/停止，模式非常清晰：前半程的心脏代价令后半程无以为继。建议与Eleen约定心率上限（如145次/分），以保证全程都能真正跑完。
